title: Three-shot anime opening, drafted at 480p
technique: several first-frame shots, cheap tier first, joined afterwards
style: Anime key visual, cel shading, bold clean lines, saturated sunset palette, cinematic lighting.

keyframes.prompt: A girl with a red scarf stands on a rooftop water tank at sunset, wind in her hair, the city below. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Low-angle camera rises past her as the scarf and hair whip in the wind, lens flare from the setting sun. Rising guitar intro.

keyframes.prompt: The same girl running along a train platform as a train pulls in, motion lines, petals in the air. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Tracking shot alongside her as she runs, the train blurring past, petals swirling. Driving drums.

keyframes.prompt: Close-up of the same girl turning to look over her shoulder, determined expression, the sky full of paper lanterns. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in on her face as she turns and smiles, lanterns drifting upward. The music hits the chorus.
